Maa Baglamukhi Shatru Shaman Maha Mantra

॥ ॐ ह्लीं बगलामुखि सर्वदुष्टानां वाचं मुखं पदं स्तम्भय ।
जिह्वां कीलय बुद्धिं विनाशय ह्लीं ॐ स्वाहा ॥

Through the divine power of this Maha Mantra, the hostile intellect of adversaries is neutralized, their evil plots boomerang onto themselves, and the devotee achieves total spiritual protection and victory without violence.

Vedic Ritual Process & Vidhi

Conducted strictly according to classical Tantra Vidhi by Pandit Harshit Sharma at Nalkheda Siddhapeeth:

1

Name & Gotra Sankalp

16 sacred offerings including yellow silk garments, turmeric roots, yellow mustard, lotus seeds, and Panchamrit.

3

Mantra Japa & Dashansh Havan

Blazing sacrificial fire fed with pure desi cow ghee, rare herbs, and yellow mustard to awaken Stambhan energy.

4

Siddha Bhasma & Prasad Delivery

Consecrated Havan ash, energized yellow Raksha Sutra, and Mata's Prasad dispatched to your address via Speed Post.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Common questions answered for devotees regarding Shatru Vijay Puja

Q. Does this puja cause harm to anyone?

Answer: No, this puja is performed purely in a satvik manner for divine self-defense and righteous protection. Maa Baglamukhi upholds Dharma by immobilizing hostile thoughts and attacks directed at the devotee.

Q. Can I watch the puja live over video call from my home?

Answer: Yes! Devotees across India and overseas participate via live WhatsApp video call for the personal Sankalp and Purnahuti darshan. High-definition video recordings are also shared.

Q. How do I receive the Prasad and Raksha Sutra?

Answer: Upon ritual conclusion, the energized Peethambara Raksha Sutra, sacred Havan Bhasma, and Prasad are dispatched via India Post Speed Post, arriving within 3 to 5 business days at your doorstep.
